---
title: "Examples"
---

Short scripts from the `examples/` folder, each ending with its figures. Run
one with `uv run python examples/<name>.py`.

Beam:

- [Static shape](beam_static.qmd): sag of a clamped span under its weight
  with the three bending laws, and the bending boundary layer at the clamps.
- [Free vibration](beam_dynamic.qmd): a clamped span released from 1.5 times
  its static shape; the Bouc-Wen hysteresis damps it.

Cable:

- [Under its weight](cable_static.qmd): the catenary, parabolic and elastic
  closed forms.
- [Under wind and ice](cable_static_load.qmd): the static solver with a load
  on top of the weight.
- [Free vibration](cable_dynamic.qmd): out-of-plane and in-plane frequencies
  against the taut-string one.
- [Wind fatigue](cable_wind_fatigue.qmd): a turbulent wind run and the
  rainflow count at the Poffenberger-Swart point.

Stockbridge (experimental):

- [Stockbridge damper](stockbridge.qmd): the damper solvers, and a span with
  two dampers.
